_comment: Canonical evidence report (visual-evidence contract). Written to .logs/evidence/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<taskId>.json; PNGs live in the sibling <taskId>/ dir, referenced by relative name. Superset of the former gamedev probe-report: Unity entries keep before/after pairs; web/mobile checkpoints set shotBefore/descriptionBefore to null. 'description' is written by the eyes agent from the pixels and is required on every capture. Date is LOCAL (date +%F). Re-runs append -2, -3 to the taskId.

captures.text: While submerged, oxygen drains and the HUD bar reflects the current value each tick.
captures.action: InputTestFixture: hold Submerge for 3s; PlayMode smoke OxygenDrainSmokeTests.Submerged_DrainsAndHudReflects
captures.descriptionBefore: Player idle at the surface; HUD oxygen bar full (100%), blue segment spans the whole gauge; no warning tint.
captures.description: Player submerged near seafloor; HUD oxygen bar visibly reduced to ~80%, right edge of the blue segment retracted; numeric readout shows 82.
captures.note: shotAfter HUD bar at ~82% matches the NDJSON current=82.0; ValueChanged fired once.

captures.text: Checkout form renders the new discount field after load.
captures.description: Checkout form with four labeled inputs; new 'Discount code' field visible between email and card number; submit button enabled; no layout overflow at 1280px.
